sample_unit: paired surgeon evaluations of model outputs (10 synthetic vignettes, 8 raters)

links.outcome: Standalone LLM output ratings by surgeons; confounding of presentation clarity with clinical ratings
links.effect: Clarity correlated strongly with clinical domains (rho 0.74-0.79); adjusting for clarity attenuated o1 advantage by 55% to over 100%, leaving no detectable clinical-domain difference.
links.quote: Clarity correlated strongly with the clinical domains (rho 0.74-0.79); adjusting for clarity attenuated the o1 advantage by 55% to over 100%, leaving no detectable clinical-domain difference.

unlisted_practices: Format-normalised evaluation designs to separate presentation quality from clinical content in LLM evaluation

screen.reason: Evaluates two reasoning-tuned LLMs (OpenAI o1 and DeepSeek R1) using synthetic clinical vignettes evaluated by spine surgeons. It assesses model output quality rather than testing a specific implementation or deployment safeguard.
